licences.author: Ricordi piano reduction, as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages in six chunks: each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on zoomed images of the page by a separate judge, then stitched and checked bar by bar against the print by five fresh proofreaders and corrected. The Soprani and Tenori chorus staves are split into one line per printed part (a note sung by the whole section is on every line). Playback tempo ♩ = 151, so that it lasts as long as the median (4:48) of six complete recordings (Kleiber 1977 4:34, Muti 1980 4:41, Santini 1954 5:10, Panizza 4:55, Bellezza 4:27, Serafin 5:04).
